title: Dispatch: candidate pack record, registry evidence dispositions, historical audit scope banners (attempt 1)
description:
Owning bead: eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 (read its title, description, ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA and notes; the 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-09 rebaselines are operative). Authority: ADR 0020 and docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md section 5.9 (the nine-condition re-freeze bar). Base: origin/main after PR #696 (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.4.1) merged. Every prerequisite of 19.6.1 is closed, so the CANDIDATE PACK is the committed pack at this branch's merge commit.

This bead changes NO pack bytes and NO importer code. If you find a source-fidelity defect, do not fix it here: file it with `bd create` (parent eshyra-o9bd.19.6, label importer), add `bd dep add eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 <new>`, and record it in your report.

COUNT HYGIENE: never hand-copy a generated count (record totals, readiness census, ledger entry count) into prose. Point at the generated artifact or the command that prints it.

DELIVERABLES

(A) Durable dispositions for the 14 `accepted` finding-registry rows that carry no statusReasoning (docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json is the source of record, contract in finding-registry.md). Membership is a deterministic query: rows with status 'accepted', no statusReasoning, and owningBead not eshyra-o9bd.19.4.4. At main bfbe47f9 those are:
 - source-authority-sol-cap-008, source-authority-fable-f1, -f5, -f7, animal-friendship-authority (eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1)
 - locator-completeness, ambiguous-coverage, rock-gnome-boundary, spellcasting-granularity, vehicle-tool-row, wererat-crossbow, source-provenance-fields, container-continuation (eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2)
 - half-damage-branches (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3)
For EACH row:
 - read the owning bead's close reason and notes, and its children's;
 - find the merged repair and its committed evidence (test file and/or generated artifact);
 - CHECK THE CURRENT PACK yourself to confirm the repair is still reflected. Read the records/fields and the source sentence, and run the evidence test.
Then add a statusReasoning in the existing style ('Repaired by <bead> (PR #N, merge <sha>): <what the pack now does>. Evidence: <test path>.'). Use the pit-variants row as the model. If a row's repair is NOT reflected in the current pack, do not write a reasoning for it: file a bead as above. Update findingRegistry.test.ts pins only where its pinned reasoning count/list legitimately changes.

(B) In-band scope banners on historical audit artifacts (bar #4, truthful in-band scope). These files describe the 2026-06-17 audit of commit 0f5b3dc under the WITHDRAWN pre-ADR-0020 freeze bar, and make unqualified claims such as 'complete across all generated record kinds' and 'clean of every known importer failure mode':
 - docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/README.md
 - provenance.md
 - record-counts.md
 - audit-methodology.md
 - mechanics-projection-report.md
 - 2026-07-01-external-audit-positive-assurances.md
 - any other file in that directory, outside thaw-notes/, that you find making a completeness, freeze-sign-off or 'no defects' claim (grep for them; list each in the report).
Add at the top of each a short blockquote banner stating:
 - it is a HISTORICAL record of <its date/commit>, preserved as evidence and not as a claim about the current pack;
 - its completeness/sign-off conclusions were withdrawn by ADR 0020 and the 2026-06-28 re-audit thaw;
 - the operative bar is section 5.9 of the integrated transition design;
 - current candidate evidence is the candidate record in (C) and, later, eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 / eshyra-o9bd.16.
Do NOT rewrite or delete historical content, and do not touch freeze-manifest.json or the README's freeze-protection instructions beyond the banner. The re-freeze bead eshyra-o9bd.14 owns rewriting them. Add a thaw note (thaw-notes/TEMPLATE.md) only if a touched path is freeze-protected; check freeze-manifest.json's file list.

(C) Candidate record: docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-11-01-o9bd-19-6-1-candidate-pack.md. Sections:
 1. What the candidate is: the committed pack directory at the merge commit of this PR. Stating 'the merge commit of PR #<n>' is enough; no SHA is needed in-file.
 2. How to reproduce: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out ...` and `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`, plus the source PDF sha256 as recorded in packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json (cite the file; you may quote the hash because it is a fixed input, not a count).
 3. Prerequisite reflection: a table of every 19.6.1 prerequisite bead -> its closing PR -> the registry rows it owns -> their status. Generate the table from `bd show` plus the registry; do not guess.
 4. Positive capabilities: point to packages/core/src/rules/deterministicCapabilityLedger.ts (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12) as the authoritative ledger of capabilities in force. State that the absence of a binding is not a completeness result, and that engine-pending magic-item clauses are the generated unselected backlog, which the DM adjudicates and which the candidate does not claim to execute.
 5. Explicit unresolved limits (bar #9), each with its owning bead:
    - eshyra-o9bd.19.3.5: undeclared condition-name reference leaves; one-hop expansion does not reach the imposed condition record;
    - adjudicated-by-design and engine-pending readiness clauses (DM-adjudicated);
    - eshyra-kbzm: magic-item `excludes` is not enforced at runtime (the Candle state machine enforces its only use);
    - eshyra-j9rc: the Pipes of the Sewers variable spend lacks real-pack evidence;
    - the freeze guard is inactive until eshyra-o9bd.14.
    Check `bd list --status open` under eshyra-o9bd.19 / eshyra-olc5 for any other open item the candidate must disclose, and include it.
 6. Non-claims: no universal clause, mechanic, deterministic or discovery completeness; passing this record authorizes only the next gates (eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3).

EVIDENCE: no new permanent test, unless the registry test needs updated pins. Proof machinery is proportionate; the registry already has a contract test.

COMPLETION PROOF: `npm run verify:worktree` passes, and the commit is on the assigned branch only. Report: per-row evidence for (A), the banner file list for (B), and any filed defect beads.
